notes.title: The Tower Stories Green 1: Kickstarter Campaign Launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960962/c29dd638bc6e44f979960cfce13ba9f90274e2ae.png[/img]

Dear Gamers and Supporters,

Today, as the Seals And Equilibria team, we have officially launched our Kickstarter campaign for our game, "The Tower Stories Green 1." This is a significant milestone! Our game blends immersive visual novel storytelling with a rich science fiction fantasy universe and stunning anime style.

"The Tower Stories Green 1" invites you to step into a world where humanity and alien forces confront each other, and every decision matters. Inspired by RPG adventures, our game promises a unique gaming experience by mixing adventure and strategy with a deep story.

Why Kickstarter?
We believe in the power of community and crowdfunding to bring ambitious projects to life. Kickstarter allows us to communicate directly with you, our valued fans, and involve you in the development process. Your support will help cover the costs of everything from development to art and music, thereby making "The Tower Stories Green 1" the best it can be.

How You Can Help:

Support our campaign: Choose from various donation levels, each with its unique rewards, including digital downloads, special in-game content, comics, and more.
Spread the Word: Share our Kickstarter page on social media, forums, and with friends who you think will love the game. Every share greatly supports us!
Add to Steam Wishlist: Stay updated on our progress and be instantly notified when "The Tower Stories Green 1" is released.
Special Kickstarter Rewards:
We've prepared exciting rewards for our supporters, including early access offers, limited edition merchandise, and opportunities to be featured in the game. Check our Kickstarter page for all the details.

Thank you for considering supporting "The Tower Stories Green 1." With your help, we can turn this game into reality faster and share this incredible story with the world.

Keep following us for updates, and thank you for joining us on this adventure.

Love,
Seals And Equilibria Team

[https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thetowerstories/the-tower-stories-green-1?ref=user_menu]

Your support is invaluable to us. Let's bring "The Tower Stories Green 1" to life together!
